subject: math.AG
name: Hilbert Nullstellensatz
statement: Over an algebraically closed field k, the ideal of the common zero set of an ideal I in k[x_1, ..., x_n] is the radical of I. Thus radical ideals correspond to affine algebraic subsets of k^n.

subject: math.AG
name: Noether normalization lemma
statement: Let k be a field and A a nonzero finitely generated commutative k-algebra of Krull dimension d. There is a polynomial subalgebra k[y_1, ..., y_d] over which A is a finite module; geometrically, every affine variety admits a finite morphism to affine space of the same dimension.

subject: math.AG
name: Chevalley constructibility theorem
statement: The image of a constructible subset under a morphism of finite type between Noetherian schemes is constructible.

subject: math.AG
name: Dimension-of-fibers theorem
statement: Let f:X to Y be a dominant morphism of integral varieties over an algebraically closed field. There is a nonempty open subset U of Y such that each fiber over a closed point of U has dimension dim(X)-dim(Y).

subject: math.AG
name: Generic smoothness theorem
statement: Let f:X to Y be a dominant morphism between smooth varieties over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. There is a nonempty open subset U of Y such that the restriction f^(-1)(U) to U is smooth.

subject: math.AG
name: Zariski main theorem
statement: A separated quasi-finite morphism of finite type between Noetherian schemes factors as an open immersion followed by a finite morphism.

subject: math.AG
name: Valuative criterion for properness
statement: A separated morphism f:X to Y of finite type is proper if and only if every commutative diagram from the spectrum of a valuation ring R to Y and its fraction field to X admits a lift Spec(R) to X. Separatedness makes the lift unique.

subject: math.AG
name: Riemann-Roch theorem for curves
statement: For a smooth projective connected curve C over an algebraically closed field, a divisor D, and a canonical divisor K, one has l(D)-l(K-D)=deg(D)+1-g, where g is the genus and l(D)=dim H^0(C,O(D)).

subject: math.AG
name: Serre duality
statement: Let X be a smooth projective variety of dimension n over a field k and E a vector bundle on X. There is a natural perfect pairing between H^i(X,E) and H^(n-i)(X,E_dual tensor omega_X), where omega_X is the canonical line bundle.

subject: math.AG
name: Serre vanishing theorem
statement: If X is projective over a Noetherian ring, L is an ample line bundle, and F is a coherent sheaf on X, then H^i(X,F tensor L^m)=0 for every i greater than zero and every sufficiently large m.

subject: math.AG
name: Finiteness of coherent cohomology
statement: If X is a proper scheme of finite type over a field k and F is a coherent sheaf on X, then every H^i(X,F) is a finite-dimensional k-vector space.

subject: math.AG
name: Hilbert polynomial theorem
statement: For a projective scheme X over a field with a fixed very ample line bundle O_X(1), and a coherent sheaf F, the Euler characteristic of F tensor O_X(m) is a polynomial in m. If F is nonzero, its degree is the dimension of the support of F.

subject: math.AG
name: Bezout theorem for plane curves
statement: If two projective plane curves of degrees d and e over an algebraically closed field have no common component, the sum of their intersection multiplicities over all intersection points is de.

subject: math.AG
name: Bertini smoothness theorem
statement: For a smooth quasi-projective variety embedded in projective space over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, a general hyperplane section is smooth. Here general means that the hyperplane lies in a suitable nonempty Zariski open subset of the dual projective space.

subject: math.AG
name: Hironaka resolution of singularities
statement: Every integral variety over a field of characteristic zero admits a proper birational morphism from a smooth variety that is an isomorphism over the original smooth locus.

subject: math.AG
name: Zariski connectedness theorem
statement: If f:X to Y is a proper birational morphism of integral Noetherian schemes and Y is normal, then every fiber of f is connected.

subject: math.AG
name: Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch theorem
statement: For a proper morphism f:X to Y between smooth projective varieties and a class a in K_0(X), ch(f_!a) times td(T_Y) equals f_*(ch(a) times td(T_X)) in the rational Chow ring of Y. Here f_! is the alternating sum of higher direct images.

subject: math.AG
name: Castelnuovo contraction theorem
statement: On a smooth projective surface over an algebraically closed field, a smooth rational curve of self-intersection minus one can be contracted to a smooth point. The resulting surface is smooth and projective, and the original surface is its blow-up at that point.

subject: math.AG
name: Riemann existence theorem
statement: For a smooth complex algebraic variety X, analytification gives an equivalence between finite etale covers of X and finite topological covering spaces of its associated complex analytic space.

subject: math.AG
name: Hasse-Weil bound for curves
statement: If C is a smooth projective geometrically connected curve of genus g over the finite field with q elements, then the absolute value of the number of its rational points minus (q+1) is at most 2g times the square root of q.
